figures.claim: Matched B2/P input and tool flow differ at the source gate and bounded repair
Show actual task completion and every required baseline, including a strong deterministic reference
figures.form: horizontal dots with actual three-decoding-seed range; companion family matrix only if legible
figures.source: actual locked receipts after complete analysis
figures.unit: % of32 authored cases per decoding seed
figures.uncertainty: three-seed min/max, not a biological CI

figures.claim: Show observed completion against actual runtime without hiding deterministic cost
figures.form: direct-labeled scatter; log latency only if its range warrants it; no lines between model families
figures.timing_scope: single CPU runtime/order/prompt-cache conditions; all attempt costs retained

tables: Completion, abstention, fallback, malformed response and numeric errors with actual denominators
Actual compute/calls/tokens/wall; unknown failed-call costs are not zero
Eight matched no-repair anchors, compared with P on the same cases only
rules: No fabricated missing values or intervals
No baseline omission if P loses
No significance stars or Pareto claim without a computed estimand
SVG plus300dpi PNG and editable code
At least8.5pt text at final size; inspect color, grayscale, clipping and manuscript insertion
